long_biography.plain_text:
Studying nearly 60 biscuit, chocolate and food factories gave Murat Ülker an operating education before he led Yıldız Holding's international expansion. His preparation included specialist courses in the United States and Germany and an internship at Continental Baking. At Yıldız, that technical grounding informed vertical integration and successive cornerstone investments.

Godiva and United Biscuits brought international brands and production into the group. Yıldız later combined United Biscuits, Ülker and DeMet's Candy under London-based pladis, giving the businesses a common global structure. Ülker collects modern art and Islamic calligraphy. Yıldız displays works from the collection at its Çamlıca campus, where the public can arrange free visits.
